scenario: A volunteer coordinates a small community puzzle table.
memory_focus: The puzzle should remain available across several visits rather than be finished in one sitting.
detours: Discuss making space for newcomers, then what to do when people disagree about a piece.

scenario: A local craft gathering considers whether children should be able to attend.
memory_focus: Children may attend with an adult who stays responsible for them.
detours: Discuss choosing a simple shared activity, then how to keep materials easy to reach.

scenario: A community group wants a gentle way to gather suggestions after an event.
detours: Discuss asking useful open questions, then how to respond when opinions conflict.

scenario: Someone helps neighbours organise a sidewalk chalk afternoon.
memory_focus: Drawings should stay away from the doorway so the entrance remains clear.
detours: Discuss ways to start a collaborative picture, then welcoming people who arrive late.

scenario: A community storytelling event has several willing speakers.
memory_focus: The user wants speakers to tell their own stories, not stories assigned by organisers.
detours: Discuss keeping contributions brief, then how to transition between speakers.

scenario: A neighbourhood group is setting up an informal outdoor reading session.
memory_focus: People can bring any reading material; there is no assigned text.
detours: Discuss creating a comfortable atmosphere, then how to close the gathering naturally.

scenario: A resident plans a community table for sharing household tips.
memory_focus: Suggestions are personal experiences, not claims that every method works for everyone.
detours: Discuss inviting contributions, then how to respond to contradictory tips.

scenario: An organiser is planning a small residents' discussion about improving a shared courtyard.
memory_focus: The group is gathering ideas only; no changes have been approved.
detours: Discuss making room for quieter voices, then keeping the conversation focused.

scenario: A beginner learns to fold a fitted sheet and wants to build confidence through practice.
memory_focus: The user prefers one instruction at a time.
detours: Discuss finding a clear work surface, then how to handle a lopsided fold without starting over.

scenario: A person wants to learn basic hand stitching using scrap fabric.
memory_focus: They are practising a running stitch, not repairing a garment yet.
detours: Discuss holding fabric comfortably, then how to keep practice relaxed when stitches vary.

scenario: A beginner wants to learn how to pack a reusable shopping bag efficiently.
memory_focus: The user wants soft fruit kept above heavier items.
detours: Discuss grouping purchases before packing, then carrying a bag comfortably.

scenario: Someone is learning to use a paper planner without making every day feel crowded.
memory_focus: They want one blank space each day for unexpected needs.
detours: Discuss distinguishing commitments from possibilities, then reviewing a week without self-criticism.
